meta.name: mode-creator
meta.description: Interactively create, install, activate, and verify custom claude-mem modes, including domain-specific observation types, concept tags, optional Telegram alerts, bot setup, worker restart, and startup-context verification. Use this whenever someone asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, track domain-specific notes, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not use the word "mode."

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 定制Claude的记忆模式,让重要内容按场景自动记录
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望Claude按场景记住关键信息并提醒你
copy.tagline_en: Create custom memory modes so Claude tracks what matters by scenario
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want Claude to remember key details per scenario and remind you

howto.what: 装上后,当用户要求定制 claude-mem 记什么时,Claude 先通过提问了解工作内容和隐私边界,再提出观察类型与标签方案;获批准后安装并启用自定义 mode,重启本地后台服务,并验证启动上下文里确实出现该 mode。可选:为特定类型或标签配置 Telegram 通知。
howto.when: 当用户要求定制 claude-mem 的记忆内容、创建或修改 mode、添加观察类型或标签,或要求针对特定记忆发 Telegram 通知时触发;即使没提“mode”也会处理。

say.text: 帮我为法律学习建一个自定义 mode,记录判例规则、考试陷阱和学说冲突。
say.note: 会先问细节并给你确认分类方案。

say.text: 我想在记录生产事故或成本发现时,给对应笔记打标签并收到 Telegram 提醒。
say.note: 会先确认范围和 Telegram 设置再安装。

say.text: 做软件笔记时,我改一下 code mode,想跟踪实验结论和数据契约变更。
say.note: 会先访谈,再提出可选的定制方案。

howto.what_en: When asked to customize what claude-mem remembers, Claude interviews the user, proposes observation types and tags, then after approval installs and activates the custom mode, restarts the worker, and verifies it in startup context. If wanted, it sets Telegram alerts for chosen types/tags.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to customize what claude-mem remembers, create or change a mode, add observation types or tags, or send Telegram notifications for particular memories—even if they do not say “mode.”

say_en.text: Create a custom mode for law study that records case rules, exam traps, and doctrinal conflicts.
say_en.note: It interviews you, then proposes the taxonomy for approval.

say_en.text: Notify me on Telegram whenever it records production incidents or cost findings.
say_en.note: It confirms the trigger scope and Telegram setup first.

say_en.text: Adapt code mode to track experiment outcomes and data-contract changes.
say_en.note: It first asks about your workflow, then proposes a variant.
